commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Antonio Rapuano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' 2 - 0 Goal! Alessandro Gabrielloni passes the ball to the feet of Nico Paz (Como), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.
90+6' Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+6' Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) is adjudged offside.
90+3' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Patrick Cutrone laid the ball off to Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+3' Ben Lhassine Kone (Como) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Como players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ben Lhassine Kone (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
87' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Como as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
86' Referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Como. Let’s see what happens!
86' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Como for a penalty. Play continues.
85' Alieu Fadera (Como) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
85' Angelino (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Antonio Rapuano signals.
84' What a chance that is! Nico Paz (Como) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
80' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post!
80' Gabriel Strefezza comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
79' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Ben Lhassine Kone (Como) replaces Lucas Da Cunha.
78' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Matias Soule (AS Roma) for Paulo Dybala.
76' A sweet pass inside the box gives Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
73' Nico Paz (Como) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Mile Svilar to dive and make a save.
73' A clumsy foul by Manu Kone (AS Roma) and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
68' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
68' The total number of attempts is 12:5.
68' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
67' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the top right corner, but Mile Svilar is alert and makes a decent save.
66' Patrick Cutrone (Como) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Belotti leaves the pitch and Patrick Cutrone (Como) comes on.
64' Substitution. Sergi Roberto (Como) replaces Yannik Engelhardt.
62' Substitution. Saud Abdulhamid leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma).
62' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
62' Enzo Le Fee goes off the pitch and Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) comes on.
61' Andrea Belotti (Como) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
61' Ooh that was close! Alieu Fadera (Como) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
61' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Andrea Belotti (Como) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Now Como have a corner.
57' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
57' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) will deliver the corner kick.

56' Alieu Fadera (Como) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the top left corner, but Mile Svilar pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
56' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
56' Nico Paz (Como) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
55' Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
55' Poor challenge! Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) is penalised for tripping and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle.
54' Pepe Reina displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
50' Nico Paz (Como) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Mile Svilar rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

48' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
48' A quickly taken corner by Como.
48' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) comes on the pitch for Stephan El Shaarawy.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Pepe Reina.
44' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) brings his opponent down. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
43' The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick. A lofted cross from Angelino (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
41' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

41' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Antonio Rapuano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Como are awarded a free kick.
39' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
34' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation.
30' Saud Abdulhamid (AS Roma) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
28' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Manu Kone (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
28' Angelino (AS Roma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
26' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
19' OFF THE BAR! Nico Paz (Como) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
18' Manu Kone (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. Como have a free kick from a promising distance.

17' Angelino (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for AS Roma.
16' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
16' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
15' Angelino (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 24:76.
11' The corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is hurriedly cleared.
6' Wasted opportunity. Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
6' Manu Kone (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
6' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
5' Saud Abdulhamid (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' Angelino (AS Roma) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Como will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano will supervise the game today.
